notablePrerequisites:
Lore Broker does not have summoning sickness.
You do not control an Army.
description:
Activate Lore Broker by tapping it, causing each player to loot.
Orcish Bowmasters triggers for each card opponents draw this way.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target, then creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Orc Army enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.
